name: Cramped padding
description: Text is too close to the edge of its container. Two shapes: (1) an element with its own text where the padding is too low for the font size, and (2) a wrapper with text-bearing children and near-zero padding against a visible boundary (border, outline, or non-transparent background) GÇö children land flush against the boundary line. Add at least 8px (ideally 12GÇô16px) of padding inside bordered, outlined, or colored containers.
snippet: <div> "video-slider-container": children flush against bg on all sides (no inset)

name: Positioned child clipped by overflow container
description: A clipping container (overflow hidden or clip) wrapping an absolutely-positioned child cuts off tooltips, menus, and popovers that need to escape. Let the overflow be visible, or move the positioned layer out of the clip.

name: Nested cards
description: Cards inside cards create visual noise and excessive depth. Flatten the hierarchy GÇö use spacing, typography, and dividers instead of nesting containers.

name: Glowing shadow accents
description: Colored glow shadows GÇö a zero-offset chromatic halo (box- or text-shadow) on any background, or any colored blurred shadow on a dark background GÇö are the default "cool" look of AI-generated UIs. Use neutral elevation shadows and subtle, purposeful lighting instead.
